Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser2

Class StyleAtomTrie<T>

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser2.StyleAtomTrie<T>
public final class StyleAtomTrie<T> extends Object
A set-trie: every declaration is stored under the sorted path of StyleAtom it requires, and findMatching(StyleQuery) walks it once to return every declaration whose required atom set is a subset of the query's -- the same test as the legacy element.snames.containsAll(declaration.snames) (plus stereotypes), but sharing common prefixes across declarations instead of re-testing each one in turn, and with no separate plain/legacy storage to keep in sync. depth(n) / * play no part in the trie's atom alphabet at all: every stored entry carries its own LevelConstraint alongside its payload, checked as a cheap side-condition once a candidate is found by the atom walk, exactly as designed. The payload type T is deliberately opaque to the trie: net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.StyleIndex is the only indexing structure using it today, over legacy net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.Style objects (T = Style), but nothing here is specific to that type.

    • findMatching

      public List<T> findMatching(StyleQuery query)
      Every stored payload whose required atoms are all present in query's, and whose LevelConstraint accepts the query's, in the order the trie holds them (roughly insertion order for entries sharing the same atom path). This does not merge or rank the results -- that is resolver work, left for later.
